youtube_best_seo_description:
Why 'rm -rf *' fails when dealing with 100,000+ files, and how to use 'find -type f -exec ... {} +' for safe, chunked batch operations.

⚡ Command:
find /path -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -exec rm {} +

instagram_viral_caption:
Avoid `rm -rf *` on giant folders! ⚠️

When directories have 100k+ files, the shell throws 'Argument list too long' errors.

Use `find -type f -mtime +30 -exec rm {} +` to safely clean files older than 30 days without choking the kernel.

Share with your team! 🛡️
